title: Do Job Applicants Consider Founder Race and Gender? Evidence from a Field Experiment
title_zh: 求职者会考虑创始人的种族和性别吗？来自实地实验的证据
title_primary: 求职者会考虑创始人的种族和性别吗？来自实地实验的证据
title_secondary: Do Job Applicants Consider Founder Race and Gender? Evidence from a Field Experiment
authors: Kaisa Snellman, Peter Younkin
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Do job seekers consider the race or gender of an employer when applying for a job? Although we have extensive research on employer-side discrimination, we know less about employee-side biases and their consequences. In this study, we examine how the gender and race of the employer shape the willingness of prospective employees to apply for a job. To examine this, we conducted a field experiment where we randomized real jobseekers into three conditions according to employer demographics. We find that job candidates were less likely to apply to a job when they learn that the founders are Black, and, when they did apply, they requested 10% higher salary. In addition, the more qualified a candidate, the less likely they were to apply to Black founders, leaving Black founders with a pool of candidates that is smaller, worse, and more expensive than their White peers. We find no gender penalty for White female founders. Findings from two survey experiments suggest that the penalty is unique to White applicants evaluating Black founders and reflects a concern among White applicants that they will be less likely to fit within a firm and that the firm is less likely to be successful in the long run. We find no evidence of a widespread applicant homophily where all applicants favor founders of their own ethnic group, nor do we find evidence of widespread statistical discrimination whereby all applicants penalize Black founders for being atypical members of the entrepreneurial class. This paper was accepted by Olav Sorenson, organizations. Funding: Financial support from the INSEAD Alumni Fund is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481 .
abstract_zh: 求职者在申请工作时，是否会考虑雇主的种族或性别？尽管关于雇主方歧视的研究已相当丰富，但我们对雇员方偏见及其后果知之甚少。本研究探讨了雇主的性别和种族如何影响潜在求职者的申请意愿。为此，我们开展了一项实地实验，根据雇主的人口统计特征，将真实求职者随机分配到三种情境中。研究发现，当求职者得知创始人为黑人时，他们申请该职位的可能性较低；即便申请，他们要求的薪资也高出10%。此外，候选人资质越高，申请黑人创始人职位的可能性越低，这导致黑人创始人面临的候选人群体规模更小、质量更差且成本更高，与白人创始人相比处于劣势。我们未发现白人女性创始人面临性别惩罚。两项调查实验的结果表明，这种惩罚仅出现在白人求职者评估黑人创始人时，反映出白人求职者担心自己在该公司难以融入，且认为该公司长期成功的可能性较低。我们未发现广泛的求职者同质性偏好，即所有求职者都偏向于同族裔创始人；也未发现广泛的统计性歧视，即所有求职者因黑人创始人是创业者阶层中的非典型成员而对其施加惩罚。本文由组织领域编辑Olav Sorenson接受。资金支持：感谢欧洲工商管理学院校友基金提供的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481获取。

title: The implications of climate change for monetary policy
title_zh: 气候变化对货币政策的影响
title_primary: 气候变化对货币政策的影响
title_secondary: The implications of climate change for monetary policy
authors: Solveig K. Erlandsen, Sui-Jade Ho, Danae Kyriakopoulou, James Talbot, Edwin Millar
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Climate change and the transition to net zero are reshaping the macroeconomy, with important implications for monetary policymakers’ core price-stability objectives. As physical hazards become more frequent and severe, and as governments’ mitigation policies reallocate resources across the economy, central banks may increasingly face challenging trade-offs between stabilising inflation and supporting output. This column discusses the implications of climate change for monetary policy, including its effects on inflation, output, monetary transmission, structural economic factors and central bank communications. It introduces a practical framework for central banks as they assess, respond to, and communicate about climate-related shocks.
abstract_zh: 气候变化及向净零排放的转型正在重塑宏观经济，对货币政策制定者的核心价格稳定目标产生重要影响。随着物理危害日益频繁和严重，以及政府减缓政策在经济中重新分配资源，中央银行可能越来越面临在稳定通胀与支持产出之间的艰难权衡。本文探讨了气候变化对货币政策的影响，包括其对通胀、产出、货币传导机制、结构性经济因素及中央银行沟通的作用。文章为中央银行评估、应对及沟通气候相关冲击提供了一个实用框架。

title: Digital dividends across boundaries: inter-regional investment under enterprise digital transformation
title_zh: 跨边界数字红利：企业数字化转型下的区域间投资
title_primary: 跨边界数字红利：企业数字化转型下的区域间投资
title_secondary: Digital dividends across boundaries: inter-regional investment under enterprise digital transformation
authors: Haoyang Wang, Manyu Huang, Lu Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Inter-regional investment plays a critical role in enabling capital flows and fostering coordinated regional development. Drawing on the micro-level behaviour of establishing inter-regional subsidiaries, this study examines the impact of enterprise digital transformation on inter-regional investment using data on Chinese A-share listed companies from 2011 to 2023. Results show that enterprise digital transformation significantly facilitates inter-regional investment. The primary mechanisms involve increasing the level of specialized division of labour, enhancing information transparency, and improving operational performance. The facilitative impact is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises, industries with high competition, and regions with well-developed factor markets. Further analysis reveals an inverted U-shaped distance pattern in this effect. Digital transformation encourages investment towards peripheral and border cities, although core and non-border destinations benefit more. Moreover, inter-regional expansion under digital transformation contributes to a smaller inter-city economic development gap. Through micro-level empirical evidence, this study highlights the digital dividends of enterprise digital transformation across regional boundaries, offering strategic insights for enterprises navigating digital transformation and optimizing investment decisions, while informing government efforts to promote coordinated and sustainable development. KEYWORDS: Digital transformation inter-regional investment specialized division of labor information transparency operational performance JEL CLASSIFICATION: O33 G34 R11
abstract_zh: 跨区域投资在促进资本流动和推动区域协调发展方面发挥着关键作用。本研究基于设立跨区域子公司的微观行为视角，利用2011年至2023年中国A股上市公司的数据，考察了企业数字化转型对跨区域投资的影响。结果表明，企业数字化转型显著促进了跨区域投资。其主要机制在于提升专业化分工水平、增强信息透明度以及改善经营绩效。这一促进作用在非国有企业、竞争激烈的行业以及要素市场发达的地区中更为显著。进一步分析显示，该效应呈现倒U型的距离模式。数字化转型推动投资向边缘城市和边境城市延伸，但核心城市和非边境目的地受益更多。此外，数字化转型下的跨区域扩张有助于缩小城市间的经济发展差距。本研究通过微观层面的实证证据，揭示了企业数字化转型跨越区域边界的数字红利，为企业推进数字化转型和优化投资决策提供了战略参考，同时为政府促进协调可持续发展提供了政策启示。关键词：数字化转型；跨区域投资；专业化分工；信息透明度；经营绩效 JEL分类：O33 G34 R11

title: Private Finance and Climate Investment Needs: An Analytical Framework
title_zh: 私人融资与气候投资需求：一个分析框架
title_primary: 私人融资与气候投资需求：一个分析框架
title_secondary: Private Finance and Climate Investment Needs: An Analytical Framework
authors: Chen Chen & Charlotte Gardes-Landolfini & Annapurna Mitra & Henk Jan Reinders
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Achieving climate-related commitments and mitigating related risks to macroeconomic and financial stability require improving the conditions for private investment. Raising sufficient private finance is however challenging, particularly for emerging markets and developing economies. This paper develops an analytical framework to assess how reforms shape private climate finance. Key dimensions include macrostructural reforms to lower capital costs, measures to incentivise financing for climate-related investments, and blended financing that leverages public resources to attract private investment. To the extent the resulting externally-financed investments are resilience- and growth-enhancing, these can also support strengthening of the longer-term balance of payments position. Effective implementation may require international support, especially for developing economies
abstract_zh: 实现气候相关承诺并缓解宏观经济与金融稳定所面临的相关风险，需要改善私人投资条件。然而，筹集充足的私人融资颇具挑战性，尤其对于新兴市场和发展中经济体而言。本文构建了一个分析框架，用以评估改革如何塑造私人气候融资。关键维度包括降低资本成本的宏观结构性改革、激励气候相关投资融资的措施，以及利用公共资源吸引私人投资的混合融资。由此产生的外部融资投资若能增强韧性和促进增长，亦有助于改善长期国际收支状况。有效实施可能需要国际支持，尤其是对发展中经济体而言。

title: Monetary–Fiscal Policy Interactions in Korea: A QPM-Based Analysis
title_zh: 韩国货币-财政政策互动：基于QPM的分析
title_primary: 韩国货币-财政政策互动：基于QPM的分析
title_secondary: Monetary–Fiscal Policy Interactions in Korea: A QPM-Based Analysis
authors: Alexander Borodin & Matteo Ghilardi & Tommy Lee & Victoria Petrenko
official: 官方在线 2026-08-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a quarterly projection model for Korea with an integrated fiscal block, enabling analysis of monetary-fiscal interactions. The model is validated through historical decompositions and forecast evaluation. Scenario analysis comparing dynamics with and without debt-stabilizing fiscal rules reveals a fundamental trade-off: rules generate short-run procyclicality but prevent permanent debt drift. Without rules, temporary nominal GDP movements cause lasting debt-to-GDP changes. For Korea, facing age-related spending pressures, a medium-term fiscal framework could safeguard sustainability.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含整合财政模块的韩国季度预测模型，用以分析货币与财政政策之间的相互作用。通过历史分解和预测评估对模型进行了验证。情景分析比较了在有无债务稳定财政规则下的动态变化，揭示了一个基本权衡：规则虽引发短期顺周期性，但能防止债务的永久性漂移。若无规则，名义GDP的暂时波动将导致债务与GDP比率的持久变化。鉴于韩国面临与人口老龄化相关的支出压力，采用中期财政框架或可保障可持续性。

title: Relative Performance Evaluation, Sabotage and Collusion
title_zh: 相对绩效评估、破坏与合谋
title_primary: 相对绩效评估、破坏与合谋
title_secondary: Relative Performance Evaluation, Sabotage and Collusion
authors: Matthew Bloomfield, Catarina Marvao, Giancarlo Spagnolo, Tomaso Duso, Joseph E. Harrington, Jr 等
official: 官方在线 2020-07-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine whether the potential for costly sabotage is a deterrent to firms' use of relative performance evaluation ("RPE") in CEO pay plans. We exploit illegal cartel membership as a source of variation in the potential for costly sabotage and document that firms are more likely to use RPE if they are currently cartel members. Moreover, firms frequently drop RPE from their CEOs' pay plans immediately after their cartels are detected. We further provide suggestive evidence that the potential for costly sabotage explains these patterns; cartel membership severs the empirical association between RPE and competitive aggression.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了潜在的高成本破坏行为是否会阻碍企业在CEO薪酬计划中采用相对绩效评估（“RPE”）。我们利用非法卡特尔成员身份作为潜在高成本破坏行为变异的来源，并记录到当前为卡特尔成员的企业更倾向于使用RPE。此外，在卡特尔被查处后，企业往往立即从CEO薪酬计划中移除RPE。我们进一步提供了提示性证据，表明潜在的高成本破坏行为解释了这些模式；卡特尔成员身份切断了RPE与竞争性攻击行为之间的实证关联。

title: When pollution improves efficiency: air quality and labour investment in firms
title_zh: 当污染提升效率：空气质量与企业劳动投资
title_primary: 当污染提升效率：空气质量与企业劳动投资
title_secondary: When pollution improves efficiency: air quality and labour investment in firms
authors: Haonan Huang, Diqiang Chen, Junjie Bian
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using Chinese listed firms outside heavily polluting industries from 2009 to 2020, we show that higher local air pollution raises measured labour investment efficiency. We identify this effect using city-level thermal inversions and atmospheric ventilation coefficients as instruments for pollution. We explain the pattern through government pressure reallocation. Local governments face simultaneous targets for growth, employment stability, and environmental improvement. When pollution increases environmental scrutiny on high-polluting industries, firms outside those industries, especially local state-owned enterprises and politically connected firms, become key carriers of growth and employment objectives. Consistent with this mechanism, pollution increases a local multi-objective pressure index, and the estimated effect is strongest where multi-objective pressure is high. Firm-level evidence shows that the adjustment is accompanied by higher employee welfare spending. The apparent improvement is not followed by higher productivity, profitability, or market value, and it sometimes predicts weaker performance. These findings show that pollution reallocates policy pressure and induces labour expansion by firms with capacity to absorb social and employment responsibilities. Our study reveals a hidden organizational cost of air pollution. KEYWORDS: Air quality labour investment efficiency government pressure reallocation multi-objective pressure JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q53 G32 M54
abstract_zh: 基于2009至2020年中国非重污染行业上市公司数据，研究发现本地空气污染加剧显著提升了企业劳动投资效率。本文利用城市级逆温现象与大气通风系数作为污染的工具变量识别该因果效应，并通过政府压力再分配机制解释这一现象。地方政府同时面临经济增长、就业稳定与环境改善的多重目标。当污染加剧导致重污染行业面临更严格的环境监管时，非重污染行业企业——尤其是地方国有企业和具有政治关联的企业——成为承载增长与就业目标的关键主体。机制检验表明：污染加剧会提升地方多目标压力指数，且该效应在多目标压力较高地区更为显著。企业层面证据显示，劳动投资效率提升伴随员工福利支出增加，但并未带来生产率、盈利能力或市场价值的同步提升，甚至在某些情况下预示着更差的经营表现。这些发现表明，污染通过重新分配政策压力，促使具备社会就业吸纳能力的企业进行劳动力扩张。本研究揭示了空气污染隐藏的组织成本。

title: DP751 Multiple Equilibria in a Growth Model with Monopolistic Competition
title_zh: 垄断竞争增长模型中的多重均衡
title_primary: 垄断竞争增长模型中的多重均衡
title_secondary: DP751 Multiple Equilibria in a Growth Model with Monopolistic Competition
authors: Jordi Galí, Martin Wolf, Leopold Zessner-Spitzenberg, Agustín Bénétrix, Hayley Pallan 等
official: 官方在线 1993-01-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a simple growth model with imperfect competition in which demand conditions can affect the dynamics of capital accumulation, hindering or enhancing growth. In our model the elasticity of the demand schedule faced by a typical firm depends on the aggregate savings rate. The latter feature results from a wedge between the elasticity of substitution across inputs in productive activities and the elasticity of substitution across goods in consumption. When the demand elasticity is constant or inversely related to the savings rate the equilibrium dynamics are shown to be qualitatively identical to those found in the perfectly competitive one-sector growth model: there is a unique stationary equilibrium which is saddle-point stable. In contrast, when the demand elasticity is positively related to the savings rate, multiple stationary equilibria (as well as multiple non-stationary equilibrium paths converging to them) emerge for some parameter values. In the latter case, the model can account for permanent differences in per capita income across homogeneous economies (even when the initial conditions are identical), as well as the absence of capital flows from rich to poor countries.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含不完全竞争的简单增长模型，其中需求条件能够影响资本积累的动态过程，从而阻碍或促进经济增长。在该模型中，典型企业面临的需求曲线弹性取决于总储蓄率。这一特征源于生产活动中投入品替代弹性与消费中商品替代弹性之间的差异。当需求弹性为常数或与储蓄率呈负相关时，均衡动态在性质上与完全竞争的单部门增长模型相同：存在唯一的稳态均衡且满足鞍点稳定性。相反，当需求弹性与储蓄率呈正相关时，某些参数取值下会出现多重稳态均衡（以及收敛于这些均衡的多重非稳态均衡路径）。在后一种情况下，该模型可以解释同质经济体之间人均收入的持久差异（即使初始条件完全相同），以及资本无法从富国流向穷国的现象。

title: The effect of health insurance expansion on price and demand for medications among the uninsured
title_zh: 医疗保险扩展对无保险人群药品价格与需求的影响
title_primary: 医疗保险扩展对无保险人群药品价格与需求的影响
title_secondary: The effect of health insurance expansion on price and demand for medications among the uninsured
authors: Chuanzi Yue
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Social health insurance expansions can affect not only new beneficiaries but also those who remain outside the program. This paper studies these spillovers in the context of Medicare Part D. Increases in insured demand can raise or lower price depending on market conditions: they may increase price when pharmaceutical firms face less elastic demand, but reduce price when demand concentration strengthens bargaining and pass-through in competitive markets. I find that Part D lowered the out-of-pocket unit price paid by Americans under age 65 without prescription drug insurance. Price declines are larger in therapeutic classes more exposed to Part D and in classes with stronger within-class competition, consistent with a demand-concentration channel. Demand increases mainly for generic drugs and among existing users. The implied consumer-surplus gain is roughly $76 per person per year, comprising about $65 from lower price on inframarginal consumption and $11 from additional consumption. Demand responses appear strongest among lower-income, younger, and healthier uninsured individuals, consistent with greater pre-existing non-adherence. Although price fall across several drug classes, demand does not increase significantly for medications associated with greater overuse in the United States, suggesting potentially positive net health spillovers.
abstract_zh: 社会医疗保险的扩展不仅会影响新增受益者，还可能影响那些仍处于计划之外的人群。本文以联邦医疗保险D部分为背景，研究这些溢出效应。受保需求的增加可能根据市场条件提高或降低价格：当制药企业面临较低的需求弹性时，价格可能上升；但当需求集中度增强议价能力并在竞争性市场中促进传导时，价格则可能下降。我发现，D部分降低了65岁以下无处方药保险的美国人所支付的自付单位价格。价格下降在受D部分影响更大的治疗类别以及同类内部竞争更强的类别中更为显著，这与需求集中渠道一致。需求增长主要集中于仿制药和现有使用者群体。由此产生的消费者剩余收益约为每人每年76美元，其中约65美元来自边际内消费的价格下降，11美元来自额外消费。需求响应在低收入、较年轻和较健康的未参保个体中表现最为明显，这与既有较高的不依从性一致。尽管多种药物类别的价格均有所下降，但与美国过度使用相关的药物的需求并未显著增加，这表明可能存在正向的净健康溢出效应。

title: Volatility Disagreement in the Options Market
title_zh: 期权市场中的波动率分歧
title_primary: 期权市场中的波动率分歧
title_secondary: Volatility Disagreement in the Options Market
authors: Turan G. Bali, Bryan T. Kelly, Mathis Mörke
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We construct a novel stock-level measure of volatility disagreement as the cross-sectional dispersion of realized variance forecasts built from heterogeneous information sets and machine learning models. Sorting single-name delta-hedged straddles on this measure yields a long-short return of −5.14% per month, robust to known option return predictors and not subsumed by disagreement about first moments or the variance risk premium. A one-standard-deviation increase in volatility disagreement is associated with a 30% rise in option position opening. The cross-sectional patterns of our disagreement measure align with recent theoretical advances of beliefs and pricing of variance claims. Evidence on attention, ownership, and arbitrage costs is more consistent with mispricing than risk compensation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种新颖的个股层面波动率分歧度量指标，该指标基于异质性信息集与机器学习模型生成的已实现方差预测的横截面离散度。基于该指标对单名股票德尔塔中性跨式期权进行排序，可产生月均-5.14%的多空收益，该收益对已知期权收益预测因子具有稳健性，且未被关于一阶矩的分歧或方差风险溢价所解释。波动率分歧每增加一个标准差，期权头寸开仓量将上升30%。我们分歧度量指标的横截面特征与近期关于信念及方差索取权定价的理论进展相吻合。关于关注度、所有权及套利成本的证据更支持错误定价而非风险补偿的解释。

abstract: We study a Force-down/Shoot-down intervention in Brazil that led cocaine traffickers to shift from air to river routes. Using data on cocaine production, homicides, and the network of rivers in the Amazon, we provide evidence that violence increased in municipalities along river routes originating from Andean producing countries after the policy. We also show that, during the same period, violence in these municipalities became more responsive to cocaine production in origin countries. We document an instance of crime displacement over the three-dimensional space, involving sophisticated adaptations from criminals regarding transportation technologies, with dramatic side-effects for local populations.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了巴西的“迫降/击落”干预政策，该政策导致可卡因贩运者从空中路线转向河流路线。利用可卡因产量、凶杀案数据以及亚马逊河流网络，我们提供了证据表明，在该政策实施后，源自安第斯生产国的河流沿线城市的暴力事件有所增加。我们还发现，在同一时期，这些城市的暴力事件对原产国可卡因产量的反应变得更加敏感。我们记录了一个三维空间内犯罪转移的案例，涉及犯罪分子在运输技术上的复杂适应，并对当地居民产生了严重的副作用。

authors: Yumeng Cui, Yongmiao Hong, Naijing Huang, Yicheng Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper revisits the predictive power of asset prices for inflation, focusing on individual stock prices rather than aggregate indices. Using a large panel data of firm-level stock prices and applying machine learning techniques, we demonstrate that individual stock prices significantly enhance the accuracy of inflation forecasts, particularly over medium- to long-term horizons and during periods of high inflationary and deflationary pressure. Compared to composite and industry-level stock indices, other aggregate asset prices, and Fama-French factors, individual stock prices contain valuable heterogeneous information, offering richer insights for inflation forecasting. These findings provide new empirical support for macro-finance theory, affirming the predictive value of asset prices from a micro-level perspective.

title: The impact of growth on the transmission of patience

abstract: The idea that patience is an important determinant of economic growth is well rooted in the economic literature. This paper investigates the causal relationship going in the opposite direction, i.e., from growth to patience. We propose a simple theoretical framework where patience evolves endogenously over time as a result of parental effort to transmit it to their offspring. Our model links such effort, and thus the overall level of patience in an economy, to economic growth. We corroborate our theoretical mechanism by estimating the impact of growth shocks on proxies of both patience and parental engagement to educate children to patience.
abstract_zh: 耐心是经济增长重要决定因素的观点在经济文献中根深蒂固。本文探讨了相反方向的因果关系，即从经济增长到耐心。我们提出了一个简单的理论框架，其中耐心随时间内生演化，源于父母将其传递给后代的努力。我们的模型将这种努力，以及经济中耐心的总体水平，与经济增长联系起来。我们通过估计增长冲击对耐心代理指标及父母教育孩子耐心参与度的影响，来验证我们的理论机制。

title: Persistent Temperature, Capital Structure, and the Long-Run Level of Output
title_zh: 持续温度、资本结构与长期产出水平
title_primary: 持续温度、资本结构与长期产出水平
title_secondary: Persistent Temperature, Capital Structure, and the Long-Run Level of Output
authors: Ha Nguyen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper shows that separating persistent (permanent) temperature changes from transitory weather fluctuations can reshape our understanding of the macroeconomic costs of warming. Using a Kalman filter state-space decomposition, it separates temperature into a permanent component and transitory weather fluctuations, and links the permanent component to trend output using a panel cointegration and error-correction framework. A one-degree Celsius higher permanent temperature is associated with a significant decline in the long-run level of output, with full adjustment unfolding over multiple decades to a century. Decomposing aggregate output into population and output per capita reveals that the long-run output losses operate primarily through demographic adjustment in the full sample, while in advanced economies, both long-run output per capita and population decline as the climate warms. Economies with higher capital intensity and more durable capital stocks experience larger long-run per capita output losses. These findings suggest that long-run economic vulnerability to persistent warming is more broadly distributed across rich and poor countries than the short-run weather literature implies, reflecting differences in capital structure. They complement rather than contradict the well-established finding that developing countries are more exposed to short-run weather shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，将持续性（永久性）气温变化与暂时性天气波动区分开来，可以重塑我们对气候变暖宏观经济成本的理解。通过使用卡尔曼滤波状态空间分解方法，本文将气温分解为永久性成分和暂时性天气波动，并利用面板协整与误差修正框架将永久性成分与趋势产出联系起来。永久性气温每升高1摄氏度，产出的长期水平将显著下降，且完全调整过程需跨越数十年至一个世纪。将总产出分解为人口与人均产出后发现，在全样本中，长期产出损失主要通过人口结构调整实现；而在发达经济体中，随着气候变暖，长期人均产出与人口均出现下降。资本密集度更高、资本存量更耐用的经济体，其长期人均产出损失更大。这些发现表明，相较于短期天气波动文献的结论，持久性气候变暖对长期经济的脆弱性在富国与穷国之间分布更为广泛，这反映了资本结构的差异。该结论并非否定发展中国家更易受短期天气冲击的既有发现，而是对其形成补充。

title: Mapping US Tariff Shock at Product Level and Assessing the Transmission Effects of the Supply Chain: A Case of Indian Textile Industry
title_zh: 产品层面美国关税冲击的测度及供应链传导效应评估：以印度纺织业为例
title_primary: 产品层面美国关税冲击的测度及供应链传导效应评估：以印度纺织业为例
title_secondary: Mapping US Tariff Shock at Product Level and Assessing the Transmission Effects of the Supply Chain: A Case of Indian Textile Industry
authors: Raju, Sunitha, VC, Sabeer, Shah, Ninad
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: With India facing highest US reciprocal tariff of 50%, this paper estimates the Direct and Indirect effects of the tariff shock on Indian Textile industry. Using a CES demand model, we estimate the counterfactual demand under 50% and 25% tariff scenarios, structured into two stages. In the first stage, we quantify the tariff induced import changes of 656 textile products at HS 6-digit level and decompose into Direct Tariff effect and Third country tariff effect (Indirect). In the second stage, we quantify the transmission effect along the supply chain using I-O tables. Our analysis shows that US textile imports from India would decline by over US$ 6.6 billion under 50% tariff. Apparel and Made ups face the largest losses. Given the inter-industry linkages, first-order indirect effects are US$ 4.6 billion, including US$ 1.4 billion within the textile sector. Chemicals, agriculture, and trade services account for roughly 40% of these upstream losses. The alternative 25% tariff scenario results in a decline of US$ 2.1 billion in US textile imports, implying that the punitive tariff accounts for the additional US$ 4.5 billion. We conclude that India should negotiate for 25% or lower tariff and focus on alternate markets.
abstract_zh: 面对美国对印度征收50%的最高互惠关税，本文估算了关税冲击对印度纺织业的直接与间接影响。通过采用CES需求模型，我们模拟了50%和25%两种关税情景下的反事实需求，并分两个阶段进行分析。第一阶段，我们量化了关税对656种HS六位码纺织产品进口变化的影响，并将其分解为直接关税效应和第三国关税效应（间接效应）。第二阶段，我们利用投入产出表量化了供应链上的传导效应。分析表明，在50%关税下，美国从印度进口的纺织品将减少超过66亿美元，其中服装和制成品损失最大。考虑到行业间关联，一阶间接效应达46亿美元，其中纺织业内部占14亿美元。化学品、农业和贸易服务约占这些上游损失的40%。在25%关税的替代情景下，美国纺织品进口将减少21亿美元，这意味着惩罚性关税导致了额外的45亿美元损失。我们得出结论：印度应争取25%或更低的关税，并聚焦于替代市场。

title: When Protection Fails: Disasters and Violence Against Women
title_zh: 当保护失效：灾害与针对女性的暴力
title_primary: 当保护失效：灾害与针对女性的暴力
title_secondary: When Protection Fails: Disasters and Violence Against Women
authors: Rafat Mahmood, Pushkar Maitra
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Natural disasters are a growing global threat, yet their consequences for gender-based violence (GBV) in high-income countries with strong institutional protections remain largely unknown. We address this gap using administrative crime records linked to disaster declarations at the Local Government Area level in Australia. Applying staggered difference-in-differences estimation techniques, we find that disasters cause short-run increase family, domestic and sexual violence with effects concentrated in the first one to three months following a disaster. Strikingly, these effects are larger in urban and affluent areas, an outcome that is difficult to reconcile with a pure economic-stress mechanism, and is more consistent with institutional strain and differential reporting environments. To probe the underlying pathway, we draw on complementary household survey evidence, which points to mental health deterioration and increased intra-household conflict as individual-level mechanisms. Together, our findings suggest that even well-resourced institutional settings offer only incomplete protection against disaster-induced violence against women
abstract_zh: 自然灾害正成为日益严峻的全球性威胁，然而在制度保障完善的高收入国家中，此类灾害对基于性别的暴力行为（GBV）的影响仍鲜为人知。本研究利用澳大利亚地方政府辖区层面与灾害声明相关联的行政犯罪记录，填补了这一研究空白。通过采用交错双重差分估计方法，我们发现灾害会导致家庭暴力、亲密伴侣暴力及性暴力在短期内增加，其影响主要集中在灾害发生后的1至3个月内。值得注意的是，这种影响在城市和富裕地区更为显著——这一结果难以用纯粹的经济压力机制解释，而更符合制度性压力与差异化举报环境的理论。为探究潜在作用路径，我们补充分析了家庭调查证据，发现心理健康恶化与家庭内部冲突加剧是关键的个体层面机制。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，即使资源充足的制度环境也无法完全保护女性免受灾害引发的暴力侵害。

title: The co-pricing factor zoo
title_zh: 共同定价因子动物园
title_primary: 共同定价因子动物园
title_secondary: The co-pricing factor zoo
authors: Alexander Dickerson, Christian Julliard, Philippe Mueller
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We analyze 18 quadrillion models for the joint pricing of corporate bond and stock returns. Strikingly, we find that equity and nontradable factors alone suffice to explain corporate bond risk premia once their Treasury term structure risk is accounted for, rendering the extensive bond factor literature largely redundant for this purpose. While only a handful of factors, behavioral and nontradable, are likely robust sources of priced risk, the true latent stochastic discount factor is dense in the space of observable factors. Consequently, a Bayesian Model Averaging Stochastic Discount Factor explains risk premia better than all low-dimensional models, in- and out-of-sample, by optimally aggregating dozens of factors that serve as noisy proxies for common underlying risks, yielding an out-of-sample Sharpe ratio of 1.5 to 1.8. This SDF, as well as its conditional mean and volatility, are persistent, track the business cycle and times of heightened economic uncertainty, and predict future asset returns.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了18万亿个模型，用于公司债券和股票回报的联合定价。引人注目的是，我们发现，一旦考虑了国债期限结构风险，仅凭股权和不可交易因素就足以解释公司债券的风险溢价，这使得广泛的债券因子文献在此目的上显得大为多余。尽管只有少数几个因子，包括行为性和不可交易性的，可能是定价风险的稳健来源，但真实的潜在随机贴现因子在可观测因子空间中是密集的。因此，贝叶斯模型平均随机贴现因子通过最优地聚合数十个作为共同潜在风险噪声代理的因子，在样本内和样本外均优于所有低维模型，解释了风险溢价，实现了1.5至1.8的样本外夏普比率。该SDF及其条件均值和波动性具有持续性，追踪商业周期和经济不确定性加剧时期，并能预测未来资产回报。

title: Catalysts for third-country market entry: The role of preferential trade agreements
title_zh: 第三方市场进入的催化剂：优惠贸易协定的作用
title_primary: 第三方市场进入的催化剂：优惠贸易协定的作用
title_secondary: Catalysts for third-country market entry: The role of preferential trade agreements
authors: Qiugu He, Xuan Luo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Preferential trade agreement (PTA) membership is known to divert trade volumes away from nonmember (third) countries along the intensive margin of trade, yet much less is known about its effects on third-country market entry along the extensive margin of trade. This paper examines whether PTAs catalyze market entry into third countries, and more broadly whether PTAs create spillover effects beyond member countries that matter for development. Using bilateral trade data from 1948 to 2020, we employ a difference-in-differences strategy, and find that the third-country market entry rate rises by 2.1% when the origin country has a PTA partner in the destination region, even after accounting for prior regional export experience. This effect is comparable in magnitude to both the origin and destination countries joining the WTO. We further show that this effect is stronger when the destination and the origin’s PTA partners are more closely linked through deep integration, common language, and colonial ties, and when products are differentiated or regulation-intensive. Beyond these heterogeneity analyses, we shed light on the underlying mechanism by showing that preferential PTA provisions enhance regional market access. The resulting scale effect appears to be an important channel through which higher variable profits help exporters cover the costs of entering third-country markets. Overall, our findings highlight the quantitative importance of the third-country entry effect of PTAs in explaining trade growth and offer broader implications for choosing optimal PTA partners.
abstract_zh: 优惠贸易协定（PTA）成员资格已知会沿贸易的集约边际将贸易量从非成员国（第三国）转移出去，然而，其对第三国市场进入的扩展边际影响却鲜为人知。本文考察了PTA是否促进了对第三国的市场进入，以及更广泛地，PTA是否产生了超越成员国、对发展具有重要意义的溢出效应。利用1948年至2020年的双边贸易数据，我们采用双重差分策略，发现当原产国在目的地地区拥有PTA伙伴时，第三国市场进入率上升2.1%，即便在考虑了先前区域出口经验后亦是如此。这一效应在规模上与原产国和目的地国加入世界贸易组织（WTO）的效应相当。我们进一步表明，当目的地与原产国的PTA伙伴通过深度一体化、共同语言和殖民联系更为紧密，以及当产品为差异化或监管密集型时，这一效应更为显著。除这些异质性分析外，我们通过显示优惠性PTA条款增强区域市场准入来阐明其潜在机制。由此产生的规模效应似乎是较高可变利润帮助出口商覆盖进入第三国市场成本的重要渠道。总体而言，我们的发现强调了PTA第三国进入效应在解释贸易增长中的数量重要性，并为选择最优PTA伙伴提供了更广泛的启示。

title: Forecasting with log-linear (S)VAR models: Incorporating annual growth rate conditions
title_zh: 使用对数线性(S)VAR模型进行预测：纳入年度增长率条件
title_primary: 使用对数线性(S)VAR模型进行预测：纳入年度增长率条件
title_secondary: Forecasting with log-linear (S)VAR models: Incorporating annual growth rate conditions
authors: Frieder Mokinski, Markus Roth
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This note studies conditional forecasting under conditions on annual growth rates when variables enter a (possibly structural) vector autoregressive (VAR) model in logarithms or logarithmic first differences. Imposing conditions on the annual growth rate of, for example, quarterly real GDP modeled in logarithms is challenging because annual growth rates are nonlinear functions of the log variables. We derive a linear approximation that makes annual growth-rate conditions compatible with standard conditional forecasting methods and complement it with a damped iterative correction that enforces the nonlinear annual-growth restriction up to numerical tolerance. We provide MATLAB companion code 2 that also accepts other types of conditions: (1) conditions on the path of variables entering the VAR, (2) conditions on the path of structural shocks, and (3) conditions on sums of successive variable observations.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在变量以对数或对数一阶差分形式进入（可能为结构性的）向量自回归（VAR）模型时，对年度增长率施加条件进行条件预测的问题。例如，当季度实际GDP以对数形式建模时，对其年度增长率施加条件颇具挑战性，因为年度增长率是对数变量的非线性函数。我们推导出一种线性近似方法，使年度增长率条件能与标准条件预测方法兼容，并辅以阻尼迭代修正，以确保非线性年度增长约束在数值容差范围内得到满足。我们提供了MATLAB配套代码，该代码还支持其他类型的条件：（1）对进入VAR的变量路径施加条件，（2）对结构性冲击路径施加条件，以及（3）对连续变量观测值之和施加条件。

title: Market flows and price patterns of fresh produce in Papua New Guinea
title_zh: 巴布亚新几内亚生鲜农产品的市场流动与价格模式
title_primary: 巴布亚新几内亚生鲜农产品的市场流动与价格模式
title_secondary: Market flows and price patterns of fresh produce in Papua New Guinea
authors: Minten, Bart, Anamo, Iga, Gimiseve, Harry, Hayoge, Glen, Kedir Jemal, Mekamu 等
official: 官方在线 2026-03-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study analyzes the fresh produce market in Papua New Guinea (PNG) using unique market flow and price data collected by the Fresh Produce Development Agency (FPDA) over the past 15 years across multiple markets. We document substantial flows of fresh produce from diverse production zones to major urban centers, with Port Moresby emerging as the primary terminal market. Hard fresh produce and sweet potato supplied there largely originate from the Highlands, while other staples and soft fresh produce are mostly sourced from other regions. Price analysis reveals four key patterns: (i) fresh produce prices have risen significantly relative to non-food products, particularly for items less supplied by the Highlands; (ii) prices exhibit strong seasonality—lowest at year-end and highest mid-year (June–August)—reflecting major cultivation periods and possibly seasonality in household labor availability; (iii) marketing margins have increased substantially, especially for soft fresh produce, creating new opportunities for Highland producers to compete in Port Moresby markets; and (iv) in 2023–2025, marketing and wastage costs accounted for the largest share of retail prices in Port Moresby—up to 85 percent for cabbage—while producer shares ranged from 15 percent for cabbage to 61 percent for Irish potatoes. These findings underscore evolving market dynamics and the critical role of supply chain efficiency in PNG’s fresh produce sector.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用巴布亚新几内亚（PNG）新鲜农产品发展局（FPDA）过去15年间在多个市场收集的独特市场流量与价格数据，对该国新鲜农产品市场进行了分析。我们记录了从不同生产区域流向主要城市中心的大量新鲜农产品流动，其中莫尔兹比港成为主要的终端市场。该地供应的硬质新鲜农产品和甘薯主要来自高地地区，而其他主食和软质新鲜农产品则大多源自其他区域。价格分析揭示了四个关键特征：（i）新鲜农产品价格相对于非食品类商品显著上涨，尤其是高地地区供应较少的品种；（ii）价格呈现强烈的季节性波动——年末最低，年中（6月至8月）最高——这反映了主要种植周期，并可能与家庭劳动力可用性的季节性变化有关；（iii）营销利润率大幅上升，尤其是软质新鲜农产品，为高地生产者在莫尔兹比港市场竞争创造了新机遇；（iv）在2023至2025年间，营销与损耗成本占莫尔兹比港零售价格的最大份额——卷心菜高达85%——而生产者份额则从卷心菜的15%到爱尔兰土豆的61%不等。这些发现凸显了市场动态的演变以及供应链效率在PNG新鲜农产品行业中的关键作用。

title: Bounding Omitted Variable Bias Using Auxiliary Data: With an Application to Estimate Neighborhood Effects
title_zh: 利用辅助数据界定遗漏变量偏差：以估计邻里效应为例
title_primary: 利用辅助数据界定遗漏变量偏差：以估计邻里效应为例
title_secondary: Bounding Omitted Variable Bias Using Auxiliary Data: With an Application to Estimate Neighborhood Effects
authors: Yujung Hwang
official: 官方在线 2026-03-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a method for estimating a superset that contains the linear projection coefficients of an outcome variable y onto a full set of covariates (x,z,w), when the available data are split across two independent sources. One dataset identifies the joint distribution of y and a subset of covariates (z,w), while the other identifies the joint distribution of (x,z). This framework is motivated by applications where administrative data lacks information on individual-level heterogeneities—such as preferences—but auxiliary data (e.g., survey) provide such detail. I illustrate the application of the method in estimating neighborhood effects while addressing selection into neighborhood choice. The micro Census data contain rich longitudinal residence information but limited detail on individual heterogeneity, while the auxiliary cross-sectional survey provides richer information on heterogeneity but lacks residential histories. I find that growing up in an ethnic enclave substantially increases the likelihood of living in an ethnic enclave later in life, but I find little evidence of neighborhood effects on most other cultural assimilation outcomes.

title: Morality meets risk: What makes a good excuse for selfishness
title_zh: 道德与风险相遇：什么构成自私的合理借口
title_primary: 道德与风险相遇：什么构成自私的合理借口
title_secondary: Morality meets risk: What makes a good excuse for selfishness
authors: Wanxin Dong, Jiakun Zheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Prior work finds that individuals are often less prosocial when they can exploit uncertainty as an excuse. In contrast to prior work that largely explores the relevance of excuses in the gain domain, this paper investigates the relevance of excuses in both the loss and gain domains. In our laboratory experiment, participants evaluated risky payoffs for themselves and their partners in either the gain or loss domain, with or without interpersonal trade-offs. We found that participants exhibited excuse-driven risk behaviors in both domains. We also documented significant individual heterogeneity in the degree of excuses, influenced by factors such as individuals’ risk preferences, beliefs about others’ risk preferences, and the size of the risk. We present a self-signaling model that incorporates self-image concerns to explain our experimental findings. We show that excuse-driven risk behavior arises because people misattribute their selfish behavior to risk preferences rather than a reduced level of altruism.
abstract_zh: 先前研究发现，个体在能够利用不确定性作为借口时，往往表现出较少的亲社会行为。与主要探讨获益领域中借口相关性的先前工作不同，本文研究了借口在损失和获益两个领域中的相关性。在我们的实验室实验中，参与者在获益或损失领域内，无论是否存在人际间的权衡，都对自己及其伙伴的风险收益进行了评估。我们发现，参与者在两个领域中都表现出由借口驱动的风险行为。我们还记录了借口中显著的个体异质性，这种异质性受到个体风险偏好、对他人风险偏好的信念以及风险大小等因素的影响。我们提出一个包含自我形象关注的自信号模型来解释我们的实验结果。我们表明，借口驱动的风险行为之所以出现，是因为人们将自己的自私行为错误归因于风险偏好，而非利他主义水平的降低。

title: Tasks and Black-white Inequality over the Long Twentieth Century
title_zh: 长期二十世纪中的任务与黑白不平等
title_primary: 长期二十世纪中的任务与黑白不平等
title_secondary: Tasks and Black-white Inequality over the Long Twentieth Century
authors: Rowena Gray, Siobhan O’Keefe, Sarah Quincy, Zachary Ward
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-12-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We present new evidence on the long-run evolution of occupational task content by race in the United States, 1900-2021. Black workers began the transition to better paid, cognitiveintensive modern jobs at least a generation after white workers; substantial convergence only occurred after 1960. Longitudinal data suggests that task transitions were racially biased: Black men moved to jobs with lower rewarded task content than white men, conditional on initial tasks, though gaps decreased after 1940. Routine-intensive Black workers were less likely to move up into non-routine analytic work in all periods. The results suggest that task-displacement shocks widen Black-white inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于美国1900至2021年间按种族划分的职业任务内容长期演变的新证据。黑人劳动者向薪酬更高、认知密集型现代职业的转变至少比白人劳动者晚了一代人；显著的趋同现象直到1960年后才出现。纵向数据表明，任务转换存在种族偏见：在初始任务条件相同的情况下，黑人男性转向的任务内容回报低于白人男性，尽管这一差距在1940年后有所缩小。在所有时期，从事常规密集型工作的黑人劳动者晋升至非常规分析性工作的可能性都较低。研究结果表明，任务替代冲击加剧了黑人与白人之间的不平等。

title: Public provision of healthcare and basic research: What are the joint effects on economic growth and welfare?
title_zh: 公共医疗与基础研究的提供：对经济增长和福利的联合效应是什么？
title_primary: 公共医疗与基础研究的提供：对经济增长和福利的联合效应是什么？
title_secondary: Public provision of healthcare and basic research: What are the joint effects on economic growth and welfare?
authors: Pintu Parui, Klaus Prettner
official: 官方在线 2025-01-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a generalized R&D-based economic growth model that incorporates endogenous human capital accumulation in terms of education and health and the public provision of healthcare and basic science. The government taxes households to pay for healthcare personnel and basic researchers. These employees are not anymore available for applied research and for final goods production. Thus, important tradeoffs emerge for economic growth and welfare with respect to government spending policies. While increasing public spending on health and basic research may decrease economic growth and welfare in the short run, we show that they foster economic growth in the medium run and tend to raise long-run welfare when compared to actual levels of spending in Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) countries. In addition, since public funding for healthcare tends to be rather high in most rich countries, the overall public spending shortfall is lower than previous research has shown. Our results highlight the importance of understanding the tradeoffs involved when deciding adequate public funding for healthcare and basic research.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个基于研发的广义经济增长模型，该模型将教育与健康方面的人力资本内生积累，以及医疗保健和基础科学的公共供给纳入考量。政府向家庭征税以支付医疗保健人员和基础研究人员的费用。这些员工不再能从事应用研究和最终商品生产。因此，政府支出政策对经济增长和福利产生了重要的权衡。虽然增加公共支出于健康和基础研究可能在短期内降低经济增长和福利，但我们表明，在中期内它们能促进经济增长，并且与经合组织（OECD）国家实际支出水平相比，倾向于提高长期福利。此外，由于大多数富裕国家在医疗保健上的公共资金往往较高，总体公共支出缺口低于先前研究所显示的水平。我们的结果强调了在决定医疗保健和基础研究适当公共资金时理解所涉及权衡的重要性。

title: Potential Growth Prospects: Risks, Rewards, and Policies
title_zh: 潜在增长前景：风险、回报与政策
title_primary: 潜在增长前景：风险、回报与政策
title_secondary: Potential Growth Prospects: Risks, Rewards, and Policies
authors: Sinem Kilic Celik, M. Ayhan Kose, Franziska Ohnsorge
official: 官方在线 2023-04-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Potential output growth around the world slowed over the past two decades. This slowdown is expected to continue in the remainder of the 2020s: global potential growth is projected to average 2.2 percent per year in 2022-30, 0.4 percentage point below its 2011-21 average. Emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) will face an even steeper slowdown, of about 1.0 percentage point to 4.0 percent per year on average during 2022-30. The slowdown will be widespread, affecting most EMDEs and countries accounting for 70 percent of global GDP. Global potential growth over the remainder of this decade could be even slower than projected in the baseline scenario—by another 0.2-0.9 percentage point a year—if investment growth, improvements in health and education outcomes, or developments in labor markets disappoint, or if adverse events materialize. A menu of policy options is available to help reverse the trend of weakening economic growth, including policies to enhance physical and human capital accumulation; to encourage labor force participation by women and older adults; to improve the efficiency of public spending; and to mitigate and adapt to climate change, including infrastructure investment to facilitate the green transition.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年，全球潜在产出增速持续放缓。这一趋势预计将在2020年代余下年份延续：2022-2030年全球潜在增长率预计年均2.2%，较2011-2021年均值低0.4个百分点。新兴市场与发展中经济体（EMDEs）将面临更剧烈的减速——2022-2030年间年均增速将下降约1.0个百分点至4.0%。此次放缓具有广泛性，将影响大多数EMDEs及占全球GDP七成的经济体。若投资增长、健康与教育成果改善、劳动力市场表现不及预期，或出现不利事件冲击，本十年剩余年份的全球潜在增速可能较基准情景进一步放缓0.2-0.9个百分点/年。现有政策工具箱可助力扭转经济增长疲软趋势，具体包括：强化物质资本与人力资本积累、鼓励女性和老年群体参与劳动力市场、提升公共支出效率、通过基础设施投资推动绿色转型以减缓和适应气候变化。
